Make a new aquaintance and kill some [[heket]] together.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Find [[Hayda]] in [[Sparkfly Swamp]].
* Clear out the frogmen. You have [3...0] of 3 groups remaining.
* See Bartholos for your reward.

===Reward===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Exit into Sparkfly Swamp.  Hayda will be directly north a short walk, you shouldn't need to fight any [[mob]]s on the way to get her. The three groups of hekets are to the north, you'll have to clear out some other mobs along with way but none should pose any problem to a full [[party]]. [[Map travel]] back to Gadd's Encampment for your reward.

==NPCs==
In [[Sparkfly Swamp]]
===Allies===
[[Human]] ([[Shining Blade]])
*{{P}} 20 (20) [[Hayda]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Bartholos
''Ah, <Character Name>, have I got an opportunity for you. The Shining Blade has its hands full, what with civil war, [[White Mantle]], and crazy [[Asura]]. Now we've got an infestation of '''frogmen'''. They're a threat to the camp and, frankly, they smell funny.''

''I sent one of my soldiers, '''Hayda''', to deal with them. However, she's a little brash and overconfident. I fear her head may be too much in the clouds to pay attention to what's threatening us from the muck. If you help her, you would be helping us all, and I don't have to tell you how easy it is to cash in on gratitude around here.''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Cash is good. Show me the frog!
|decline = Frogs are sacred to me.
|ask = '''Hayda''' should be in '''Sparkfly Swamp'''. I suggest you get hopping. 
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
On first meeting:
:'''Hayda''': ''"I simply cannot believe this! I, who am touched by the power of providence, am mired in this swamp...hunting frogs...instead of charging to the heights of glory."''
:'''Hayda''': ''"This is [[Livia]]'s doing. I'm sure of it. That harlot. She's afraid that I will show her up."''
:'''Hayda''': ''"Hey! You there. Did Bartholos trick you out here, too? Well, you might as well help with these frogs. The sooner we finish, the sooner I can do something meaningful!"''

After killing the first group:
:'''Hayda''': ''"Rather than doing something useful, I'm stuck tromping through the muck!"''

After killing the second group:
:'''Hayda''': ''"If only Bartholos would give me a chance to prove myself against a worthy opponent..."''

After killing the last group:
:'''Hayda''': ''"Finally. That was the last of them. The world is safe, again...unless the Shining Blade gets attacked by enormous flies."''
:'''Hayda''': ''"A job well done...by you as well. Now, Bartholos must see my true value and present me with a task worthy of my vast abilities. Come. It is time we returned to the camp."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Bartholos
''I'm glad to hear the frogmen have been dealt with. Now, maybe we can focus on matters at hand instead of worrying about croaking in the middle of the night. Hayda worries me, though. I fear that she doesn't quite understand what we are up against. One day she'll have to learn that great soldiers are made, not born...and bad soldiers are dead. But, you know all that, right?''

==Notes==
* Consider combining this quest with [[Finding Gadd]], since you will have Hayda as additional support.
* Also consider saving this quest until [[vanquish]]ing Sparkfly Swamp.

==Trivia==
* This quest is named after the [[Wikipedia:Silverchair|Silverchair]] album [[Wikipedia:Frogstomp|Frogstomp]].
